<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Requires Becoming.Strict σ, SlackDist triangle inequality, epoch step/projection invariants, block simulation and excursion bounds, explicit epoch_compat and monotone μ₂ for vertical composition, plus absorption α Δ + ε ≤ Δ and guard margin β Δ + η.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Stochastic/continuous metric contraction or real-valued ε/(1 - α) fixed-point convergence (left to future Mathlib periphery).
- Necessary existence of a LaxSim for arbitrary non-lumpable empirical dynamics.
